notes: An unparseable state on the Stop path. Unlike PreToolUse this is never fail-closed: the stop is allowed, stdout stays empty and the problem goes to one stderr note line. Blocking a stop on a parse error would trap the session. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
